analyzed_vuln.description: Stack buffer overflow due to trusting snprintf() return length without bounds check. In ra_translate_keymap(), for integer/float conversion it writes into fixed stack buffer `char str[32]` using `snprintf(str, sizeof(str) - 1, ...)`, then passes the returned `len` directly to `flb_sds_cat(buf, str, len)`. When formatted output is longer than 31 bytes, snprintf truncates but returns the full would-have-been length, causing flb_sds_cat/memcpy to read past `str` on the stack (ASan READ overflow at flb_sds_cat).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input flows through record_ac_fuzzer: bytes -> JSON packed to msgpack -> flb_ra_create() parses accessor -> flb_ra_translate() iterates parser entries and calls ra_translate_keymap() for keymap expressions. Trigger requires keymap lookup to resolve to a numeric value (FLB_RA_INT or FLB_RA_FLOAT) whose formatted decimal string length exceeds 31 chars (e.g., large/precise float), so snprintf truncates `str[32]` but returns larger len; that oversized len is then used as copy size in flb_sds_cat, causing out-of-bounds stack read from `str`.
